note: Named full-battle sim setups. Every sheet thread runs 'current' unless it says otherwise; only the kit maintainer moves 'current', and only when the Battle sim thread says a setup is final. Paths are relative to the repo root. 'env' is passed to the binary as is; EG_VALUE and GRID_DIR are added by the kit (GRID_DIR is the team's own grid).

v4-eg5.status: What the published Trick Room Six picks (sheet Versions 13-16) were run with. About 4.5 s per game per thread on an idle Mac.

v8-dp2-race-eg7.status: Battle sim's candidate (two-turn Protect check, damage race). NOT FINAL as of 2026-10-05: do not base a sheet on it yet. About 5-5.5 s per game per thread.
